tables.name: Shinkira Naming Method
tables.description: Original two-method Shinkira scheme, 70% geographical and 30% inherited/historical. Engine-compatible simple tables.

results.name: Geographic Compound
results.description: Two-part place names drawing from Shinkira mountains, forests, waters, cultivated land and a few Utsuro-influenced stems. Ordinary direct joining; no curated variants.

results.name: Historic Family or Settlement
results.description: Inherited family, shrine, castle and old settlement elements joined to common town endings. Ordinary direct joining; no curated variants.
